verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a general facility for users to define event-to-action rules, such as workflow automations or registrable webhooks. The closest items are adjacent rather than user-defined rules: a fixed Slack-channel-to-customer association, marketing copy about automatic routing and labeling of feedback, and agent delegation on issue assignment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
